# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

Only the latest release receives security fixes.

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Do not open a public issue for security problems.

Report it privately via
[GitHub Security Advisories](https://github.com/release-please-oss/release-please-action/security/advisories/new).
We aim to acknowledge reports within 7 days and will keep you updated until a fix is released.

Vulnerabilities in the `@release-please-oss/release-please` library should be reported to
[release-please-oss/release-please](https://github.com/release-please-oss/release-please/security).
